dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the division operation supplied by a division-inverse monoid structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides ordinary real division for both quotients by 2.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Applies the addition operation selected by a heterogeneous-addition instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Adds the two real terms a squared over 2 and b squared over 2.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Applies the division operation selected by a heterogeneous-division instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms each quotient of a real square by the real number 2.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Applies the multiplication operation selected by a heterogeneous-multiplication instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms the real product a times b on the left-hand side.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Applies the exponentiation operation selected by a heterogeneous-power instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Raises each of a and b to the natural-number exponent 2.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: Applies the less-than-or-equal relation supplied by an order instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: States that a times b is at most the sum of the two half-squares.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies natural-number exponentiation from a monoid structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets a to the power 2 and b to the power 2 as ordinary repeated real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Serves as the type of the exponent 2 and of the numeral indices used to construct literals.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instAtLeastTwoHAddOfNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Proves that the successor n plus 1 is at least two whenever n is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the evidence needed to interpret the numeral 2 as a real number.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instNeZeroSucc
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides evidence that every successor natural number is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Establishes that 1 is nonzero while constructing the at-least-two evidence for the numeral 2.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets a natural numeral in a type having the corresponding numeral instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Produces the natural exponent 2 and the real denominators 2, as well as auxiliary numerals 0 and 1.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Specifies the domain of the universally quantified variables and every arithmetic expression in the inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies ordinary addition on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the right-hand side the ordinary real sum of the two quotients.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instDivInvMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies ordinary real multiplication, inverse, and division, with division defined through multiplication by an inverse.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines that division by 2 is ordinary real division in each half-square term.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies the ordinary order relation on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the proposition's comparison as the usual real inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies the ordinary multiplicative monoid structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines the natural powers a squared and b squared.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies ordinary multiplication on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines the left-hand product a times b.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNatCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies the canonical embedding of natural numbers into the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets each denominator numeral 2 as the real number 2.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Turns ordinary same-type addition into heterogeneous addition with the same input and output type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Routes the displayed addition of two real quotients to ordinary real addition.

dependency_coverage.name: instHDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Turns ordinary same-type division into heterogeneous division with the same input and output type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Routes both displayed real divisions to ordinary real division.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Turns ordinary same-type multiplication into heterogeneous multiplication with the same input and output type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Routes the displayed product of a and b to ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Turns an ordinary power operation into heterogeneous exponentiation with the same base and result type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Routes exponentiation of real bases by the natural exponent 2 to ordinary real natural powers.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatAtLeastTwo
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs numerals at least two in a type by using its natural-number cast.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Constructs the real numeral 2 used as the denominator of each quotient.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets a natural-number numeral as that same natural number.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Constructs the natural numerals 0, 1, and 2 used in the exponent and numeral-instance evidence.

binders: a and b are arbitrary real numbers.
conclusions: The product a b is less than or equal to a squared divided by 2 plus b squared divided by 2.
mathematical_definitions: a squared means the ordinary real product a times a, and b squared means the ordinary real product b times b.
The numeral 2 in each denominator is the canonical real number 2, while the exponent 2 is the natural number 2.
All multiplication, addition, division, exponentiation, and order operations are the ordinary operations on real numbers.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every pair of real numbers a and b, a times b is at most one half of a squared plus one half of b squared; equivalently, ab ≤ (a² + b²)/2.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: There are no hypotheses restricting a or b; the assertion is universal over all real pairs.
The denominators are the fixed nonzero real number 2, so the divisions are mathematically well-defined and introduce no exceptional case.
The proposition is not vacuous, because it makes a concrete inequality assertion for every real pair.
